aircraft_registration: German aircraft registration (Luftfahrzeugkennzeichen): D- followed by four letters, like `D-AIMA` or `D-EABC`.
bic: BIC (SWIFT code) of a German bank: four letters, DE and two letters or digits, with an optional three-character branch code, like `COBADEFFXXX` or `DEUTDEFF`.
company_name: German company name: up to six capitalized words followed by a legal form such as GmbH, AG, KG, GmbH & Co. KG, OHG, SE, eG, GbR, UG (haftungsbeschränkt), e.K. or e.V., like `Müller Bau GmbH`.
company_register_number: German commercial register number (Handelsregisternummer): HRA, HRB or GnR and up to six digits, like `HRB 12345 B`, with the court before it when given (`Amtsgericht München HRB 123456`).
ecli: European Case Law Identifier (ECLI) of a German court decision: ECLI:DE:, the court, the year and the number, like `ECLI:DE:BGH:2017:290317UIXZR86.16.0`.
health_insurance_number: German health insurance number (Krankenversichertennummer, KVNR) as printed on the eGK card: a capital letter and nine digits, like `A000500015`.
iban: German IBAN: DE, two check digits and 18 digits, with or without spaces, like `DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00`.
iccid: SIM card number (ICCID) of a German SIM: 8949 followed by 14 to 16 digits, without spaces, like `8949020000123456788`.
id_card_number: German identity card number (Personalausweisnummer): nine letters and digits starting with L, M, N, P, R, T, V, W, X or Y, with at least one digit, like `T22000129`.
imsi: IMSI (subscriber identity on a SIM) of a German network: mobile country code 262 and 12 more digits, 15 in all, like `262011234567890`.
license_plate: German license plate (Kfz-Kennzeichen): district code of one to three letters, one or two letters and one to four digits, with an optional E or H, like `B-MW 1234` or `HH-XY 99E`.
mobile_number: German mobile number (Handynummer): 015x, 016x or 017x, national or with +49, 0049 or +49 (0), with spaces, slashes or dashes, like `0152 28817386`; only valid German mobile numbers.
mrz_id_card: Machine-readable zone (MRZ) of a German identity card or residence permit, first line (ICAO TD1): 30 characters with `D<<` as issuing country, like `IDD<<T220001293<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<`.
mrz_passport: Machine-readable zone (MRZ) of a German passport, second line (ICAO TD3): 44 characters with the passport number, `D<<` as nationality, date of birth, sex and expiry date.
msisdn: German mobile number in MSISDN form, as in telecom records: 49 and the number without its 0, 12 or 13 digits like `4915228817386`; only valid German mobile numbers.
passport_number: German passport number (Reisepassnummer): nine letters and digits starting with C, F, G, H, J or K, with at least one digit, like `C01X00T47`.
pension_insurance_number: German pension insurance number (Rentenversicherungsnummer, Sozialversicherungsnummer): area number, birth date DDMMYY, a letter and three digits, like `15 070649 C 103`; only existing area numbers.
phone_number: German phone number (Telefonnummer): 0 and the area code, +49, 0049 or +49 (0), or the area code in brackets like `(030)`, with spaces, slashes or dashes, like `030 23125000`; only valid numbers.
postal_code_city: German postal code (Postleitzahl, PLZ) and town: five digits, optionally after D-, and the place name, like `10115 Berlin`, `60311 Frankfurt am Main` or `D-06108 Halle (Saale)`.
premium_number: German premium-rate (0900), service (0180) or televoting (0137) number: the prefix and seven digits, national or with +49, like `0900 5 123456`; only valid German numbers.
street_address: German street and house number (Straße, Hausnummer): a name ending in -straße, -str., -weg, -platz, -allee, -gasse, -ring, -damm or -ufer, or like `Am Markt 3`, with numbers like 12a or 5-7.
tax_id: German tax identification number (Steuer-IdNr, Steueridentifikationsnummer): 11 digits without a leading zero, together or grouped 2-3-3-3, like `86 095 742 719`.
vat_number: German VAT number (USt-IdNr, Umsatzsteuer-Identifikationsnummer): DE and nine digits, together or in groups of three, like `DE123456788` or `DE 123 456 788`.
